FLINK-31744.title: [FLINK-31744] Include JobVertex info in sparse EG
FLINK-31744.description:
Include all JobVertex-level information in the sparse execution graph, created by the Adaptive Scheduler when in the WaitingForResources state, like the vertex id/name and the maxParallelism.
This reduces the difference in behavior between the schedulers.

This also removes the functional need for the recently introduced `JobMasterGaterway#getMaxParallelismPerVertex`.
I propose to remove this method.
We could keep it though if we are concerned that the creation of the sparse EG is too expensive.

FLINK-30585.title: [FLINK-30585][flamegraph] Collect the flame graph of a single subtask instead of all subtasks when viewing the flame graph of a single subtask
FLINK-30585.description:
## What is the purpose of the change

After [FLINK-30185](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/FLINK-30185) , we can view the flame graph of subtask level. However, it always collects flame graphs for all subtasks.

We should collect the flame graph of single subtask instead of all subtasks.

## Brief change log

[FLINK-30585][flamegraph] Collect the flame graph of a single subtask instead of all subtasks when viewing the flame graph of a single subtask

### Flame graph collection 

- The stats collected for job vertex and execution vertex will be collected into the executionVertexStatsCache.
- The stats collected for job vertex will be collected into the jobVertexStatsCache.

### Flame graph query

- The stats of job vertex will query from the executionVertexStatsCache.
- The stats of execution vertex will query from the executionVertexStatsCache.

## Verifying this change


This change added tests and can be verified as follows:

  - *Improved all old tests inside of the `VertexThreadInfoTrackerTest`*
  - *Added the `VertexThreadInfoTrackerTest#testExecutionVertexCachedStatsUpdatedAfterRefreshInterval `*

FLINK-31233.title: [FLINK-31233][Rest] Return 404 when task manager stdout/log files not exist.
FLINK-31233.description:
## What is the purpose of the change

When running Flink on Kubernetes, the stdout logs are not redirected to files so it will not shown in WEB UI. This is as expected.

But It returns “500 Internal error” in REST API and produces an error log in jobmanager.log. This is confusing and misleading.

## Brief change log
  - *Migrate some test to junit 5*
    - move TestingChannelHandlerContext out of AbstractTaskManagerFileHandlerTest
    - move TestingTaskManagerFileHandler out of AbstractTaskManagerFileHandlerTest
    - migrate AbstractTaskManagerFileHandlerTest and TaskManagerLogListHandlerTest to junit5
  - *remove the usage of mockito in TestingChannelHandlerContext*
    - create TestingChannelPipeline 
  - *return 200 and inform user to use kubectl logs to get stdout content*



## Verifying this change
  - *Add unit test to verify TaskManagerStdoutFileHandler handle FileNotFoundException and other exceptions.*
  - *Manually verified the change by running on kubernetes.*
  - give information when the stdout file does not exist.
![image](https://github.com/apache/flink/assets/5869080/a0fc1a08-db86-48d2-99aa-f28d180dd920)

  - Throw an exception when the log file does not exist. (manually deleted)
![image](https://github.com/apache/flink/assets/5869080/adc46466-3d7c-41a0-b3e3-d0870ffc9e01)

commits.author: Weihua Hu

commits.message:
[FLINK-31233][Rest] Return readable information when task manager stdout files not exist.

While running flink on kubernetes, we disable stdout redirects to files by default to allow users to get stdout logs by "kubectl logs <pod-name>".
So we need to inform users of the probable reason when they want to get stdout from web ui.
